title: Amazon aims for delivery drones to reach 500 US neighborhoods by end of 2026
summary: Amazon wants to grow its Prime Air delivery drone service sixfold to reach nearly 500 cities and towns across the United States by the end of 2026. Even DoorDash is looking to build its own in-house delivery drone program.
